name: Multi Display Adjustment
description:
Adjust external displays via DDC/CI:

• Responsive brightness/contrast sliders
• Display names as in Settings
• Placement in a Quick Settings tile or under GNOME's volume
• Individual/combined control
• Easy to get started: https://github.com/samuelcecilio/multi-display-adjustment#installation-of-ddcutil-service

DDC/CI backend by Maciej Wójcik: https://gitlab.com/w8jcik/display-adjustment
